name: Particle Road Background
description: A three.js particle background for React: a road of dots streams out of a vanishing point under a low camera, curving up into the distance, with faint accent pulses running down the lanes. Dots under the cursor lift, wobble and glow; a click sends a pulse through them. One point cloud, live settings, pauses off screen.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the lane pulses and the cursor's pocket.

props.name: curve
props.description: How far the road bends up into the distance.

props.name: pulses
props.description: Strength of the accent pulses running down the lanes (0 = none).

props.name: hover
props.description: How high the dots under the cursor lift (0 = no hover).

props.name: parallax
props.description: Tilt the view as the section scrolls through the viewport.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
